title: Design System: AGIL Ops Mobile App

body.purpose: Primary reading text, input values, message bodies.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Resting lift for buttons and small controls.

shadows.name: sm-strong
shadows.purpose: Cards and inputs needing a touch more separation.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Floating surfaces only — status menus, sheets, dialogs.

motion.name: ease-out

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The unmistakable primary action; full-width in forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0ea5e9; color: #030712; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #38bdf8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #27272a; color: #fafafa; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text field on the near-black canvas.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-input input { background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #fafafa; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #38bdf8; }

components.name: Priority Pill — Critical
components.description: Severity badge; always paired with a word, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-pill-critical { display: inline-block; background: #450a0a; color: #f87171; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 16px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Filter Tab — Active
components.description: Selected list filter; inactive siblings use #27272a / #a1a1aa.
components.css: .ds-tab-active { display: inline-block; background: #0ea5e9; color: #030712; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview: This is the cockpit of an incident, not a brochure for one. The interface behaves like instrumentation: a calm, near-black field on which a small number of meaning-carrying signals — severity, status, who's online, what to do next — light up with precision. Lifted directly from the AGIL Operations Hub web console (a ShadCN dark theme), the mobile app mirrors that system so an operator moving between the control-room desk and the field never re-learns the language. The palette is a zinc-black neutral ramp with sky blue as the single interactive voice and a tight set of semantic status colors that are never decorative. Typography is one family — Geist — worked across weights, so hierarchy comes from size and weight, not from font-mixing.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas (#09090b); depth via tonal layering, not heavy shadow.
One interactive color (sky blue); status colors reserved for status only.
Single typeface (Geist) across weights; hierarchy by size/weight.
6px radius on controls; full-round only on pills and avatars.
Glanceable: severity and status readable in under a second.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Sky blue (#0ea5e9 / #38bdf8) is the only interactive color. If something is tappable and primary, it is sky; if it is sky, it is interactive. Never use sky decoratively.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Sacred Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, and green appear only to convey severity or state. A green that means 'active incident' must never also be a 'submit' button.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist only. Do not introduce a second typeface for 'display' or 'mono'; lean on weight (300–700) and size for every level of hierarchy.

rules.name: The Layer-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a lighter neutral surface before reaching for a shadow. Shadows are for things that genuinely float above the page (sheets, menus, toasts), paired with a dim background overlay.

dos: Do keep sky blue (#0ea5e9 / #38bdf8) as the only interactive color — the One Voice Rule.
Do reserve red/amber/green strictly for severity and status, always paired with a word or icon (WCAG: never color alone).
Do build hierarchy from Geist weights (300–700) and size, not from a second typeface.
Do convey depth with the neutral ramp first (black → subtle → secondary → elevated slate); add shadow only for floating surfaces.
Do keep controls at 6px radius and pills/avatars full-round; honor 44–48px touch targets for one-handed field use.
Do lead each screen with the current incident state and one obvious next action.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS dashboard: no gradient-accent hero metrics, no background-clip:text gradient text, no identical decorative card grids.
Don't drift into cluttered legacy enterprise: no dense gray walls of controls or tiny low-contrast metadata.
Don't add overstyled flash: no glassmorphism, no neon, no heavy or bouncy motion that distracts during an incident.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored side-stripe on cards, rows, or alerts — use full hairline borders and status pills instead.
Don't spend status color decoratively (a green 'submit' button reads as an active incident).
Don't let muted text (#a1a1aa) carry body copy where it drops below 4.5:1 — bump toward Ink (#fafafa).
